item.title: uSync Commerce 18.0.2
item.description:
### Fixed
- Shipping method prices were never synced: the export didn't write them, a price change didn't change the file, and an import created the method with no prices. Prices are now exported and imported, including dynamic and real-time calculation configs. A file exported before this fix leaves the existing prices alone, and a file whose calculation mode differs from the method's is skipped with a warning, because Umbraco Commerce only sets the mode when the method is created. Every shipping method file changes on its first export after upgrading ([#23](https://github.com/Jumoo/uSync.Umbraco.Commerce/issues/23)). - Nothing was exported on save when the site called `AddUmbracoCommerce` itself in `Program.cs` (as SQLite needs, for `AddSQLite()`). `AddUmbracoCommerce` only runs its setup callback on the first call, so the package's save and delete handlers were dropped. They are now registered against the existing Commerce builder, whichever order the calls run in ([#25](https://github.com/Jumoo/uSync.Umbraco.Commerce/pull/25)). - An item deleted in Umbraco Commerce couldn't be added back by importing its file: the import reported no change and the item stayed hidden. Umbraco Commerce keeps deleted items in the database, and uSync treated them as still there. Deleted items are now ignored, and the import creates the item again. Because the deleted item keeps its key, the new one gets a new key and is matched by alias from then on. A deleted store can't be recreated this way, because other items find their store by key, so its import fails with a message saying why ([#24](https://github.com/Jumoo/uSync.Umbraco.Commerce/issues/24)).

item.title: Translation Manager 19.0.0-rc1
item.description:
Release candidate for Umbraco 19. Includes everything in 18.5.0, merged forward from `v18/main`. The main Jumoo.TranslationManager package ships alongside the core packages, still bundling the v18 connectors, which run on Umbraco 19.0.0-rc1.
- Build: Umbraco 19.0.0-rc1, Jumoo.Processing 19.0.0-rc2 (and `@jumoo/processing` ^19.0.0-rc2) and Jumoo.Json 19.0.0-rc1
- Add: the translation coverage report works for Library element sets. It lists the elements under the set's folder and links each one to the element editor. Publishing an element now records its version per culture, the same way publishing a document does, so an element translated before a later change shows as out of date - Add: when Umbraco.AI is set up on the site and the Umbraco.AI connector (`Jumoo.TranslationManager.UmbracoAi`) isn't installed, the Connectors page has a banner across the top, and the bottom of the AI connector's settings page has a small "Using Umbraco.AI?" button. Both open a dialog about the connector, with a link to the setup guide. The `HideProviderBoxes` setting, which hides the connector adverts on the Connectors page, hides these too. Translation Manager checks for Umbraco.AI by type name and has no reference to it (Jumoo/Jumoo.TranslationManager#178) - Docs: the README and NuGet description name the Umbraco.AI connector, for sites that want to translate through their Umbraco.AI setup. The bundled AI connector is still the one most sites should use (Jumoo/Jumoo.TranslationManager#178)

item.title: Jumoo.Processing 19.0.0-rc2
item.description:
Second release candidate of Jumoo.Processing for Umbraco 19.
> [!WARNING] > This is a release candidate for testing against Umbraco 19.0.0-rc1. Don't run it on a production site.
Includes everything in 18.4.0, merged forward from `v18/main`. 19.0.0-rc1 didn't have it.
### Changed
- Long runs with large results put much less load on the database. A pipeline's results are now stored compressed in their own column, and are only written again when a step changes them. - The backoffice no longer downloads a pipeline's results after every step while it is running. It gets them when the run stops, finishes, fails or waits for you.
### Upgrading
- A database migration adds the new columns to `Jumoo_Pipelines` when the site starts. Runs in progress during the upgrade carry on.
The `@jumoo/processing` npm package is published under the `next-19` tag.

item.title: AI Connector 17.8.0
item.description:
### Changed
- The job view is one compact box: translator, model, tokens, and how much of the job came from translation memory, as a percentage with "x of y items". Errors and batch state are one-line notices, and the prompt opens in a side panel. - The connector settings screen is split into a provider box and a Translation box, with advanced settings behind a cog. API keys and secrets are password inputs, and a saved model the provider no longer lists stays visible instead of switching to the first option. - New default models: `gpt-6-luna` for OpenAI, `gemini-3.6-flash` for Gemini, `claude-sonnet-5-5` for Claude and `gpt-5.4-mini` for GitHub Models and Azure. The previous Gemini and Claude defaults no longer work, so existing sites that saved them need the model changing in the connector settings. - Batch jobs now record how much translation memory covered, so the job view shows it.
### Fixed
- The Claude translator's structured requests failed on current Claude models, which reject a forced tool call, so every block fell back to one request per string. - The Azure batch deployment field was always disabled. - Azure AI Foundry saved its default model under the wrong setting.

item.title: UmbracoAI Connector 17.2.0
item.description:
### Changed
- Requires `Jumoo.TranslationManager.AI` 17.6.0 or later (was 17.4.1). - `UmbracoAiTranslator`'s constructor takes three more dependencies (`TranslationMemoryJobService`, `IHttpClientFactory`, `GlossaryService`) to match `AITranslatorBase`. It's resolved through DI, so this only matters if you construct it yourself.
### Fixed
- The connector works with current Translation Manager again. It no longer throws `MissingMethodException` at boot with Translation Manager 17.8.1 or later: it's now built against `Jumoo.TranslationManager.AI` 17.6.0, after `AITranslatorBase`'s constructor changed. - Creating a job no longer fails with `Jumoo.TranslationManager.AI` 17.7 ("returned 1 translated value(s) for N input value(s)"). The connector sends one Umbraco.AI request per string, so it returns one result per input as the library requires. - Moved off Umbraco.AI's obsolete `GetChatResponseAsync(messages)` overload.

item.title: Jumoo.Processing 18.4.0
item.description:
Includes the changes in 17.6.0, merged forward from `v17/main`.
### Changed
- Long runs with large results put much less load on the database. A pipeline's results are now stored compressed in their own column, and are only written again when a step changes them. The save after each step no longer reads the whole stored pipeline back first. On large uSync publisher pushes this cut the rows written by about 90%, which makes write lock timeouts and running out of memory much less likely. - The backoffice no longer downloads a pipeline's results after every step while it is running. It gets them when the run stops, finishes, fails or waits for you. - Closing a run's dialog clears it with a single delete instead of reading the whole run first. - Background runs no longer write a full copy of the pipeline into the queue after every step.
### Upgrading
- A database migration adds the new columns to `Jumoo_Pipelines` when the site starts. Runs that are in progress during the upgrade carry on, including any cancel already asked for. Finished runs are left as they are and still read back with their results. - `ProcessPipeline` takes a new optional `omitRunningResults` query parameter. Callers that don't send it get the whole pipeline, as before. - If a background run's pipeline is deleted between steps, the run now stops with "Pipeline not found" rather than being re-created from the previous step.

item.title: uSync Complete 18.4.1
item.description:
# v18.4.1
Brings the v17.7.1 work forward to Umbraco 18. 18.4.1 makes large Publisher pushes and pulls lighter, and fixes pulls to a server that requires approval when "Delete missing" is on. Upgrading is recommended if you push or pull a lot of content at once, or use approvals.
## Changed
- Publisher keeps long changed values (block lists, rich text and so on) shortened while a push or pull is running, so large pushes stay quick and use less memory. The change details dialog fetches the full values when you open an item, including for approvers reviewing a request. ([KevinJump/uSync#1215](https://github.com/KevinJump/uSync/issues/1215)) - Once a push or pull has finished, values that were shortened are listed as they are, under "Shortened values", rather than compared. - For developers: code that handles `uSyncPublisherActionCompletedNotification` may now find long values in the `Details` of its `Actions` shortened. The same goes for the reports an approval keeps once its run has finished.
## Fixed
- Publisher: a pull from a server that requires approval now applies when "Delete missing" is on, instead of failing with "Missing File". - Publisher: an approval whose run fails no longer shows its changes as made.
## Updated
- Jumoo.Processing 18.3.4.
## Requirements
- Umbraco 18. - uSync 18.3.1 or later. - Jumoo.Processing 18.3.4 (installed automatically).

item.title: Jumoo.Processing 18.3.4
item.description:
Includes the fixes in 17.5.4, merged forward from `v17/main`.
### Fixed
- A pipeline whose step ran but whose results then couldn't be saved is now marked Failed, with the save error in its details. Before, it stayed Running and kept the target locked, so the next run was told one was already in progress. This covers a write lock timeout, a pipeline too big to serialise, and a processor that throws while merging a step's results. - Saving a big pipeline no longer holds the processing write lock while it serialises. Other processing writes are less likely to hit Umbraco's write lock timeout while a large pipeline saves.

item.title: Translation Manager 18.5.0
item.description:
Resend a job's notification emails, a temporary licence for older keys, a much faster translation memory, and Clone to Language fixes for block properties. Includes the fixes from v17 17.11.0.
- Build: raise the bundled connector minimums to their latest v18 releases (Google 18.0.1, Microsoft 18.2.1, Xliff 18.0.2, Passthrough 18.0.1, DeepL 18.2.0, AI 18.4.1). NuGet picks the lowest matching version, so sites kept getting the older connectors, including Google 18.0.0 without the fix that only loads it when the backoffice is enabled
- Fix: the `@jumoo/translate` npm package was missing most of its types in 18.3.2 and 18.4.0, including `dist/index.d.ts`, so packages building against it failed with `TS2307` - Fix: the Quick translate button never showed in the Languages box on a document's Translation view, because the box dropped its header actions unless it was collapsable - Fix: Clone to Language left a culture-variant Block List, Block Grid, Single Block or rich text block property's blocks in the source language. Their element values and expose entries kept the source culture, so on the target page the blocks showed as drafts with no content. An invariant block property on a culture-variant page (block level variance) wasn't cloned at all. Both are now cloned to the target language, including blocks nested inside other blocks - Fix: a failed backoffice API call now shows the error notification, and is treated as an error rather than an empty result. The v18 client wasn't generated with `throwOnError`, so errors were returned instead of thrown - Fix: translation memory slowed down a lot once it held many rows. With 500,000 rows, approving a job no longer scans the memory table for every translated value, and listing, counting and deleting memory now runs in the database rather than loading every row first. Paging a source, its counts and the sources list now take milliseconds instead of seconds. Deleting all memory on SQL Server now takes 6s instead of 93s (950s to under 1s on SQLite). A migration adds two indexes to the memory table, which took about a second at 500,000 rows (Jumoo/Jumoo.TranslationManager#154) - Fix: creating a job failed on SQL Server with "String or binary data would be truncated in table 'Translate_Jobs', column 'name'" when the job's name was longer than 255 characters, which a long page name could cause because the default job name starts with it. Job names are now cut to 255 characters (ending in `...`) when they're saved (Jumoo/Jumoo.TranslationManager#157) - Fix: when translating a page and its children, the suggested job name lost the page's name and started "& Children". It's now "{page name} & Children" - Add: when the licence key is for an older version of Translation Manager, the licence page shows a warning with a button to get a one-off temporary licence. If the licence is set in appsettings, nothing is saved and the page shows the new key and domains to copy there (Jumoo/Jumoo.TranslationManager#162) - Fix: a licence within a month of expiry was replaced with a blank one when the renewal check found no new key. The existing licence is now kept - Fix: saving Translation Manager's settings, licence, connector settings or translation sets returned a 403 unless the user's group had the "Manage translations" permission. These pages are in the Settings section, so anyone with access to that section can now save them - Add: a bell button in the job page footer resends the notification emails for the job's current stage, for when a translator has lost the original email. It shows once a job is past Submitted: received and reviewing jobs resend the Received email, approved and closed jobs the Approved one. It asks before sending, and if nothing goes out it says why (notifications off, no email set up, or no recipients for that stage). Only the email is resent, so nothing else that runs when a job is received, such as auto approval, runs again (Jumoo/Jumoo.TranslationManager.Issues#109)

item.title: uSync Complete 17.7.0
item.description: - New: the change details dialog on the Publisher, Exporter, snapshot, restore point and TimeMachine rollback reports has a Side by side tab that previews the item from what's being synced (the sync pack, snapshot, restore point or rollback) rather than the site's uSync folders. Pushes preview on the target server, when the target supports it - The dialog's tabs are now Side by side, Web page, Details. Both sides are labelled Current and Incoming, with the site's name, and the incoming side is on the left - New: the licence page can get a one-off 60 day temporary licence for keys from older versions of uSync.Complete, while you upgrade - New: `uSyncPublisherActionCompletedNotification` is raised on the server that started a push or pull when it finishes, from the push dialog, headless or the background queue. It has the target server, the user, the items pushed (with their children) and the per-item results, dependencies included. `uSyncPublisher.Pipelines.Publish` gives the Publisher pipeline's alias for code handling `PipelineFinishedNotification` - Fix: a settings push or pull only sends the website folders for the file types you pick, so pushing stylesheets no longer sends `Views` - Fix: items pushed from the Sync Queue to a server that requires approval are now removed from the queue once the approval goes through - Fix: items pushed from the Sync Queue to a server that already has them are now removed from the queue, when the report finds no changes - New: a "Content & Media" server template, for sites that deploy settings and files with uSync and source control. It is first in the list and selected by default when you add a server - The "Content & Media & Settings" server template is now called "Everything", and a new server set up from it includes settings and files in its pushes and pulls. Servers you have already set up keep their settings - Fix: the Web page tab now says when an item doesn't exist on the other site yet, instead of saying there are no differences - Fix: when the Side by side tab can't preview an item, for example content whose document type isn't on the other site yet, the tab says so instead of not appearing - Fix: approvals only apply to content, media and member pushes and pulls. Pushing or pulling settings from the Settings tree (document types, templates, stylesheets and so on) no longer waits for approval, as the approval setting says - Pushing or pulling a document, media or member type now always includes its compositions, whether or not "Include dependencies" is on - New in uSync.Publisher: "Include shared values", an option on language limited pushes and pulls. The report also says when shared values were not compared - Fix: a root push with "Delete missing" ticked now deletes from the target when `AllowDeletingOfOrphanedItemsFromRoot` is set, and only for the orphan types - Fix: a full push no longer sends values for unpublished cultures - The backoffice screens now use Umbraco's own client setup, so a session that expires during a request asks you to sign in again instead of failing - Publisher's language step now says that content that doesn't vary by language is sent in full when only some languages are selected - Updated to Jumoo.Processing 17.5.3 - Updated to uSync 17.6.1. This includes the uSync 17.5.2 fixes, which keep the right values on culture and segment limited pushes, and import items that have a clean marker - Fix: a push to a site in Production mode no longer lists website file changes the site won't apply. The report shows a note when files are different instead - Fix: v17 servers can connect to each other when a URL rewrite rule or middleware changes the case of the request path, as v13 servers could - Fix: v17 servers can connect to each other on sites where authentication runs before Umbraco's pipeline in Program.cs - When a server turns down a connection, both servers now log the address they used for the request, so the two can be compared - `MaxRequestBodySize` (Publisher and Exporter) now applies on IIS as well as Kestrel, so large pushes and uploads on IIS only need `maxAllowedContentLength` raised in web.config. It only raises the limit: a site that already allows more keeps its own limit

item.title: uSync Complete 18.4.0
item.description:
# v18.4.0
Brings the v17.7.0 work forward to Umbraco 18. The headline is a Side by side preview in the change details dialog, which shows what an item will look like once it is synced. This release also adds a temporary licence for keys from older versions, a Content & Media server template, and a notification for code that needs to know when a push or pull has finished. It now requires uSync 18.3.1 or later.
## Added
- A Side by side tab in the change details dialog, on the Publisher, Exporter, snapshot, restore point and TimeMachine rollback reports. It previews the item from what is being synced (the sync pack, snapshot, restore point or rollback) rather than from the site's uSync folders. Pushes are previewed on the target server, when the target supports it. - The licence page can get a one-off 60 day temporary licence for a key from an older version of uSync.Complete, so a site keeps working while you upgrade the licence. - Publisher: a "Content & Media" server template, for sites that deploy settings and files with uSync and source control. It is first in the list and selected by default when you add a server. - Publisher: `uSyncPublisherActionCompletedNotification` is raised on the server that started a push or pull, once it finishes. That covers the push dialog, headless runs and the background queue. The notification has the target server, the user, the items pushed (with their children) and the result for each item, dependencies included. For code handling `PipelineFinishedNotification`, `uSyncPublisher.Pipelines.Publish` gives the Publisher pipeline's alias. - Publisher: an "Include shared values" option on language limited pushes and pulls. The report says when shared values were not compared.
## Changed
- The change details dialog's tabs are now Side by side, Web page and Details. Both sides are labelled Current and Incoming with the site's name, and the incoming side is on the left. - Publisher: the "Content & Media & Settings" server template is now called "Everything". A new server set up from it includes settings and files in its pushes and pulls. Servers you have already set up keep their settings. - Publisher: when a server turns down a connection, both servers log the address they used for the request, so the two can be compared. - `MaxRequestBodySize` (Publisher and Exporter) now applies on IIS as well as Kestrel. Large pushes and uploads on IIS only need `maxAllowedContentLength` raised in web.config. The setting only raises the limit, so a site that already allows more keeps its own.
## Fixed
- Publisher: approvals only apply to content, media and member pushes and pulls. Pushing or pulling settings from the Settings tree (document types, templates, stylesheets and so on) no longer waits for approval. - Publisher: items pushed from the Sync Queue leave the queue once an approval goes through, or when the report finds the target already has them. - Publisher: a settings push or pull only sends the website folders for the file types you pick, so pushing stylesheets no longer sends `Views`. - Publisher: a push to a site in Production mode no longer lists website file changes that site won't apply. The report shows a note when files differ instead. - Publisher: a root push with "Delete missing" ticked now deletes from the target when `AllowDeletingOfOrphanedItemsFromRoot` is set, and only for the orphan types. - Publisher: a full push no longer sends values for unpublished cultures. - Publisher: the language step says that content that doesn't vary by language is sent in full when only some languages are selected. - Publisher: servers connect to each other when a URL rewrite rule or middleware changes the case of the request path, and on sites where authentication runs before Umbraco's pipeline in Program.cs. - Pushing or pulling a document, media or member type always includes its compositions, whether or not "Include dependencies" is on. - The Web page tab says when an item doesn't exist on the other site yet, instead of reporting no differences. - When the Side by side tab can't preview an item, for example content whose document type isn't on the other site yet, the tab says so instead of disappearing. - The backoffice screens show an error when an API request fails. Some failures were silently ignored before.
## Requirements
- Umbraco 18. - uSync 18.3.1 or later. - Jumoo.Processing 18.3.2 (installed automatically).

item.title: Jumoo.Processing 18.3.3
item.description:
Includes everything in 17.5.3, merged forward from `v17/main`.
### Added
- The "Already in progress" panel offers **Clear it** when the run holding the target has been Running with no progress for over five minutes. After a confirm it clears that run and starts the new one. Until now a run that lost its browser kept the target locked for up to an hour, and the only way out was Delete on the Background screen. Only the run's owner or an admin sees the button. - The panel also has a **Try again** button and a "Checked" time. The panel doesn't refresh by itself, so Try again re-checks: it starts the new run if the old one has finished, and otherwise shows the latest status.
### Changed
- The conflict messages no longer suggest waiting on the panel or cancelling from it. They say to try again once the other run has finished.

With 500,000 rows, approving a job no longer scans the memory table for every translated value, and listing, counting and deleting memory now runs in the database rather than loading every row first. Paging a source, its counts and the sources list now take milliseconds instead of seconds. Deleting all memory on SQL Server now takes 6s instead of 93s (950s to under 1s on SQLite). A migration adds two indexes to the memory table, which took about a second at 500,000 rows (Jumoo/Jumoo.TranslationManager#154) - Fix: creating a job failed on SQL Server with "String or binary data would be truncated in table 'Translate_Jobs', column 'name'" when the job's name was longer than 255 characters, which a long page name could cause because the default job name starts with it. Job names are now cut to 255 characters (ending in `...`) when they're saved (Jumoo/Jumoo.TranslationManager#157) - Build: the bundled connectors are now DeepL 17.4.1, Xliff 17.0.3 and AI 17.7.3. Their backoffice clients sign in through Umbraco's `configureClient`, so a session that expires during a request asks you to sign in again instead of failing - Fix: when translating a page and its children, the suggested job name lost the page's name and started "& Children". It's now "{page name} & Children" - Add: when the licence key is for an older version of Translation Manager, the licence page shows a warning with a button to get a one-off temporary licence. If the licence is set in appsettings, nothing is saved and the page shows the new key and domains to copy there (Jumoo/Jumoo.TranslationManager#162) - Fix: a licence within a month of expiry was replaced with a blank one when the renewal check found no new key. The existing licence is now kept - Fix: saving Translation Manager's settings, licence, connector settings or translation sets returned a 403 unless the user's group had the "Manage translations" permission. These pages are in the Settings section, so anyone with access to that section can now save them - Add: a bell button in the job page footer resends the notification emails for the job's current stage, for when a translator has lost the original email. It shows once a job is past Submitted: received and reviewing jobs resend the Received email, approved and closed jobs the Approved one. It asks before sending, and if nothing goes out it says why (notifications off, no email set up, or no recipients for that stage). Only the email is resent, so nothing else that runs when a job is received, such as auto approval, runs again (Jumoo/Jumoo.TranslationManager.Issues#109)
